# spidermonkey-test262-assertion-and-load-contract: shared behavior contract

The JS test runner discovers JavaScript tests and builds each command with ancestor shell.js helpers. The test262 assert API accepts literal true and throws Test262Error on failed predicates; sameValue distinguishes signed zero and accepts NaN pairs. notSameValue rejects SameValue pairs. reportCompare compares type/value and reports the result. These helper contracts do not prove that any selected test passed.

Kind: shared. Rule: none.

Evidence: [js/src/tests/test262/shell.js:55-111](26491dd0-a301-5a35-a673-edc0fe99d474.md); [js/src/tests/lib/tests.py:245-294](99417b2a-b74c-5a4f-a255-eba6a9a86158.md); [js/src/tests/lib/manifest.py:595-621](73fdcda9-4e44-539b-ab03-ac13ab105282.md); [js/src/tests/shell.js:444-460](1e6587fa-c698-531e-a4e4-0893f25c83ee.md)

This contract applies only to independently checked member bindings. It does not establish arbitrary same-name or similar-body equivalence.
